[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended vegan pasta recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Vegan Carbonara with Mushroom Bacon: Use a cashew-based cream sauce, marinated mushrooms, and vegan bacon (made from tempeh or tofu).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Pesto Pasta with Roasted Vegetables: Toss cooked pasta with basil pesto, roasted cherry tomatoes, zucchini, and bell peppers, adding toasted pine nuts or cashews for crunch.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Spaghetti Bolognese with Lentil Meatballs: Lentil meatballs simmered in tomato sauce served with whole-grain spaghetti.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Creamy Asparagus and Pea Pasta: Blend asparagus, peas, garlic, and cashews with lemon juice and olive oil, served with linguine and cherry tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Vegan Pad Thai: Rice noodles with tamarind sauce, sautéed tofu, bean sprouts, and shredded carrots, garnished with peanuts and cilantro.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Mushroom Stroganoff: Sautéed mushrooms and onions in vegan sour cream and Dijon mustard, served over eggless noodles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. One-Pot Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Olives: Cook pasta, cherry tomatoes, and olives in pesto sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Vegan Lasagna: Layers of pasta, marinara sauce, and dairy-free ricotta made with cashews or tofu.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Spicy Pumpkin Pasta with Sage and Kale: Roasted pumpkin blended with cashews, garlic, and sage, tossed with pasta and sautéed kale.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Creamy Broccoli Pasta with Garlic Scapes: Blended steamed broccoli, garlic scapes, and cashews with lemon juice and olive oil, served with whole-grain pasta.
